issue.title: bob-project-tasks rewrites project frontmatter with processFrontMatter and its open_task_count disagrees with bob on every live project
issue.description:
## Bug

The `bob-project-tasks` plugin keeps `task_count` / `open_task_count` in every project
note's frontmatter. It does so by calling `app.fileManager.processFrontMatter` from a
`metadataCache.on("changed")` listener, debounced at 250 ms, whenever the recount
differs (`plugins/bob-project-tasks/main.js:5-6, 216-240, 548-581`). That causes two
separate problems.

### 1. The counts disagree with bob on every live project

The plugin counts only `[ ]`, `[/]`, and `[*]` rows under `## Tasks`. bob's
`projects/scan.rs:132-193` counts every open `#task` line, including blocked `[?]` rows
and `^prj`.

Reproduction (2026-11-22, live vault, `bob projects list -f json`, compared with each
note's `open_task_count:`): **43 of 43** live projects disagree. Examples:

| Project | Frontmatter `open_task_count` | bob `tasks.open` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bob` | 18 | 86 |
| `sase` | 9 | 85 |
| `sase_pre_blog` | 0 | 18 (all blocked) |

`projects.base` turns the frontmatter counts into its Tasks column, so it shows
`sase_pre_blog` as "✅ 0 open / 17".

### 2. It is a second, re-serializing frontmatter writer on project notes

`processFrontMatter` re-serializes the whole YAML block. That is the reason
`211-parent-frontmatter-plan.js` bans it elsewhere in bob-plugins. Consequences:

- It already caused `bob-cli-79`, where project promotion anchors failed because this
  write landed between the seed write and the anchor write. That bug was fixed on the
  promotion side only.
- Under epic `bob-cli-pf`, the `=+` editor writes project frontmatter through
  byte-preserving, fingerprinted `bob props update`. Every count change then:
  - re-serializes the bytes `bob props` just preserved;
  - changes the parsed mapping, so the editor's fingerprint goes stale and the next
    write gets a `prop_stale` refusal.

## Remediation options (Bryan decides)

- **(a) Retire the materialization.**
  - Drop the writer.
  - Remove the two keys once through bob's byte-preserving writer.
  - Replace the `projects.base` Tasks column. The `[!projects]` catalog card, and the
    proposed project card, carry bob's live counts.
- **(b) Move the writer into bob.** For example, `bob projects sync` writes bob's
  definition through `yaml_spans`. This keeps the Bases column, but the counts then
  update only on sync.

Either way, make the props role table mark the keys as derived until they are gone.

## Evidence

Research report `research:202611/area_project_property_cards__cld.md`, §1.5b and §8
decision 2.

task_type_fields.impact: projects.base Tasks column is wrong; project frontmatter loses byte preservation; the bob-cli-pf =+ editor gets prop_stale refusals on project notes whenever counts move; previously caused bob-cli-79.
task_type_fields.repro: Compare each live project's open_task_count frontmatter with tasks.open from 'bob projects list -f json': 43/43 disagree on 2026-11-22 (bob 18 vs 86, sase_pre_blog 0 vs 18). Any task add/close in a project note triggers a whole-block processFrontMatter rewrite 250 ms later.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching area/project property cards: this second, re-serializing writer undermines bob props' byte-preserving, fingerprinted writes on project notes and feeds wrong counts to projects.base.

payload.description: Earlier symptom of this same writer: its debounced processFrontMatter count write broke project-promotion anchors; fixed on the promotion side only

evidence.note: Independently verified during lead consolidation (2026-11-22): grep of the bob-plugins checkout confirms the two app.fileManager.processFrontMatter calls at plugins/bob-project-tasks/main.js:561 and :574, and bob-cli e98c7fe9 src/native/props/roles.rs classify() has no Area/Project arm, so task_count/open_task_count/status/done_tasks all fall through to loose() — the =+ editor would offer them as editable today. The consolidated area/project property-card report makes retiring this writer its Phase 0 prerequisite.
